//: Capability manifest for <KpiGauge> — svelte-pure-admin. FRAGMENT slice: one gauge tile (pa-kpi-gauge) of the comparison-gauges design, the sub-component <KpiGaugeList> defers through its default `children` slot. Maps the tile's own features: the sentiment variant (→ pa-kpi-gauge--*), the head label/value text (labelText / valueText → __num), the prefix/unit affixes (prefix / unit → __unit spans), the inline bar fill width (barPercent → style="width: N%" on __fill), the optional target-tick position (tickPosition → inline --pa-kpi-gauge-tick-pos on __bar; the component omits the style attribute entirely when unset), and the right scale label (scaleEndText; scaleStartText keeps its default '0'). The detail popover (KpiDetailPopover) is a separate sub-component (kpi-detail fixture) only rendered when detail props are set — none here.
